source.notes: arch-077. Verified in the sweep against src/models/sequence/hyena.py @ 02220c69: the mixer is entirely external ordinary operators — implicit long filter (positional embedding → Sin MLP → exponential modulation), depthwise short conv, per-order causal FFT convs, gate multiplies — with NO URM kernel call. The pinned HyenaOperator is runnable only via the CUDA fftconv extension (its reference path has a bias-layout broadcast bug making the non-fused operator non-executable at every configuration, verified empirically this batch); the oracle is therefore the pinned HyenaFilter (AST-extracted) for filter generation plus an equation-level transcription of the pinned forward. Layer module: architectures/hyena_operator.py.

external_stages: depthwise short conv (kernel 3, sliced to l_filter)
implicit long filter (pinned HyenaFilter: pos emb + Sin MLP + ExponentialModulation)
per-order gate multiply + causal FFT conv (fftconv_ref) + bias
params.note: no URM kernel call; FFT convs are external ordinary ops; no compact U2 realization claimed

coverage.notes: Implicit-filter parity vs the pinned HyenaFilter and operator parity vs the equation transcription (driven by the pinned filter's kernel/bias) in tests/test_architectures_hyena.py; gradients flow through the filter and projections. The pinned configuration exercised is order-2, num_heads=1, num_blocks=1, inner_factor=1 (the sweep's open question: one configuration must be pinned — this is it). outer_mixing, post_order_ffn, num_blocks>1, fused_fft_conv (CUDA) and any recurrent distillation of the implicit filter are residual variants, not claimed.
